task.title: LEAN algorithm-level smoke via artifact loader

smoke runs against 5 trading days of deterministic synthetic OHLCV (no live broker no network)
test asserts 1 OnData callback fires and 1 fill is recorded with the loaded artifact's signal
no broker credentials accessed (BROKER_PRODUCTION_LIVE_ENABLED stays false)
